column1: # The forms .github/scripts/shell_reader_forms.py generates that bash runs the client of and this
# repository's reader of shell misses: its known limits. Tab-separated: an fnmatch pattern of form
# check-log-guard.sh's network clients; stderr: its loose ci_log_guard_stderr calls), and why it
# is a limit. The generator fails on a missed form no row matches
# and on a row that matches none.
